relationships.subject: Suzetrigine
relationships.evidence_quote: It is a highly selective pain signal inhibitor of the voltage-gated sodium channel 1.8 (NaV1.8) that is selectively expressed on nociceptors within peripheral sensory nerves and dorsal root ganglia but absent from the human brain.

relationships.subject: Suzetrigine
relationships.evidence_quote: A majority of participants (90.9%) rated suzetrigine as part of MMT as good, very good, or excellent in managing their postoperative pain.

key_findings: In a phase 4 single-arm study (N=47) of laparoscopic/arthroscopic surgery, 90.9% rated suzetrigine-based multimodal therapy good to excellent for pain control.
76.1% of participants remained rescue opioid-free; suzetrigine was generally safe and well tolerated.
